description:
crate-jmap-mail-server/AGENTS.md 'Restrictions' section line: 'Do not add dependencies beyond: jmap-types, jmap-mail-types, jmap-server, tokio, thiserror'. The 'Design Constraints (Settled)' table line: 'Dependencies | jmap-types, jmap-mail-types, jmap-server, tokio, thiserror only'.

The current Cargo.toml diverges from this list in three ways:

1. mime-tree is now a hard dep (added by commit e99c3dc to implement RFC 8621 §4.1.2 As* header forms). Justified in the Cargo.toml comment but not reflected in AGENTS.md.

2. serde and serde_json are workspace deps used pervasively, but not in the AGENTS.md list (probably implicit).

3. tokio is now a DEV dep only (commit a6210dc 'drop tokio from runtime deps in all 7 server crates'). The AGENTS.md list still has it as a runtime dep alongside jmap-types etc.

4. thiserror is NOT in Cargo.toml at all — neither runtime nor dev. The AGENTS.md list still names it.

Plus the 'Async | Always async (tokio)' design-constraint row is misleading: the crate now uses 'impl Future + Send' return types (no tokio runtime hard dep), as a deliberate choice per JMAP-tco1 / commit a6210dc.

This is exactly the 'documented only in your head, not in code' pattern AGENTS.md itself flags. A new contributor reading the dep list would (a) reject a legitimate mime-tree-based feature on the grounds it's not in the list, or (b) be confused why tokio is allowed-but-only-in-dev. The AGENTS.md needs an update to reflect the current settled state of:

- mime-tree as the workspace's RFC 5322 gateway (cross-reference bd:JMAP-g7wu.11)
- tokio as dev-only (cross-reference JMAP-tco1)
- serde, serde_json as runtime
- async via Future returns, not async fn (no tokio runtime requirement)
title: AGENTS.md dependency restriction list now stale
